precompiled.name: binary_modmul_full_mt
precompiled.description: Complete deterministic 5-tape TM for (a*b) mod p. The finite control includes the outer loop/controller and in-place shift, increment, add, compare, and subtract subroutines; no external arithmetic orchestration is required.

input_convention.tape_2_P: W LSB-first modulus digits, zero-padded, followed by #
input_convention.tape_4_R: W zero digits followed by #; final result is here LSB-first

precompiled.weights: each defined (state, read tuple) is one exact sparse ReLU detector with its write/move/next-state action
precompiled.note: The generic runner does not parse decimal arithmetic. This sample starts directly from the TM's native five-tape binary representation; the arithmetic controller itself is entirely in the compiled machine.

notes: Text models use variable-order longest-known-suffix backoff.
All long compilation and run loops are executed in Web Workers.
